entries.message: Fix - Repair Up Next cards built from raw media-server data
entries.author: Lasikiewicz
details: An Up Next card whose provider data carried the episode's own ID in place of the show's now links to the correct show page instead of one that cannot load
Those cards show their poster again rather than a blank placeholder, where the media server had supplied an image address only it could resolve
A card left with no usable show identity links by title instead of to a page that resolves to nothing
